content.text:
Here's a hand-built SVG of Sonic mid-sprint. His palette uses the commonly referenced approximations of Sega's official colors (Sonic Blue `#2D7DD2`, peach `#F5C29A`, shoe red `#DA291C`, buckle yellow `#FFD100`, eye green `#00A859`).

```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 360" width="100%" height="100%" role="img" aria-label="Sonic the Hedgehog running">
  <!-- Palette: Sonic Blue #2D7DD2 | blue shade #1E5AA8 | peach #F5C29A | white #FFFFFF | shoe red #DA291C | buckle #FFD100 | eye green #00A859 | ink #1A1A1A -->

  <!-- ground + motion lines -->
  <ellipse cx="240" cy="318" rx="170" ry="14" fill="#1E5AA8" opacity="0.10"/>
  <g stroke="#2D7DD2" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.35">
    <line x1="34"  y1="150" x2="118" y2="150"/>
    <line x1="54"  y1="186" x2="124" y2="186"/>
    <line x1="78"  y1="220" x2="128" y2="220"/>
  </g>

  <!-- back leg + shoe (trailing) -->
  <g>
    <path d="M168,248 C138,250 110,262 84,288" fill="none" stroke="#2D7DD2" stroke-width="18" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M84,288 C64,287 48,295 42,312 C39,324 49,332 62,327 C76,321 90,304 90,304 Z" fill="#DA291C"/>
    <path d="M44,314 C50,306 60,302 70,305 L70,313 C60,310 52,312 47,316 Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="58" y="305" width="8" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#FFD100" transform="rotate(-26 62 309)"/>
    <ellipse cx="44" cy="320" rx="9" ry="5.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- back arm + glove (trailing) -->
  <g>
    <path d="M212,152 C182,154 158,166 136,188" fill="none" stroke="#2D7DD2" stroke-width="15" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="134" cy="192" r="15" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <path d="M124,196 q-5,8 3,13 M144,196 q5,8 -3,13" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- body leaning forward -->
  <g>
    <path d="M214,138 C200,156 192,182 196,210 C200,238 220,254 250,251 C280,248 290,226 284,202 C279,180 266,162 252,150 Z" fill="#2D7DD2"/>
    <path d="M214,138 C200,156 192,182 196,210 C200,238 220,254 250,251" fill="none" stroke="#1E5AA8" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="240" cy="206" rx="24" ry="33" fill="#F5C29A"/>
  </g>

  <!-- quills sweeping back -->
  <g fill="#2D7DD2">
    <path d="M212,66 C168,46 112,34 56,40 C92,58 140,70 196,82 Z"/>
    <path d="M214,84 C162,78 104,78 46,96 C86,104 138,108 198,104 Z"/>
    <path d="M214,104 C166,110 112,126 78,150 C118,134 168,124 206,120 Z"/>
  </g>

  <!-- head -->
  <g>
    <!-- ears -->
    <path d="M196,64 L180,34 L210,60 Z" fill="#2D7DD2"/>
    <path d="M199,61 L190,46 L207,58 Z" fill="#F5C29A"/>
    <path d="M240,62 L256,38 L250,66 Z" fill="#2D7DD2"/>
    <!-- dome -->
    <ellipse cx="224" cy="112" rx="54" ry="50" fill="#2D7DD2"/>

    <!-- muzzle -->
    <path d="M248,104 C272,100 296,108 300,126 C303,140 294,152 276,154 C256,156 236,146 232,134 C228,122 236,108 248,104 Z" fill="#F5C29A"/>
    <ellipse cx="274" cy="136" rx="8" ry="6.5" fill="#1A1A1A"/>
    <path d="M262,140 C256,150 246,152 236,150" fill="none" stroke="#1A1A1A" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>

    <!-- eyes (connected, modern green) -->
    <g>
      <path d="M206,84 C204,72 209,62 220,62 C232,62 237,70 239,86 C239,98 230,104 222,103 C214,102 208,94 206,84 Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <path d="M240,84 C240,72 246,62 258,63 C270,64 276,74 276,90 C276,102 268,106 258,104 C248,101 240,94 240,84 Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <path d="M236,82 L243,82 C244,98 241,104 239,104 C237,104 235,98 236,82 Z" fill="#1A1A1A"/>
      <ellipse cx="221" cy="88" rx="8" ry="12" fill="#00A859"/>
      <ellipse cx="258" cy="88" rx="8" ry="12" fill="#00A859"/>
      <ellipse cx="221" cy="91" rx="3.4" ry="5.4" fill="#1A1A1A"/>
      <ellipse cx="258" cy="91" rx="3.4" ry="5.4" fill="#1A1A1A"/>
      <ellipse cx="224" cy="84" rx="2.4" ry="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <ellipse cx="261" cy="84" rx="2.4" ry="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    </g>
    <!-- brow -->
    <path d="M206,84 C214,77 226,77 236,82" fill="none" stroke="#1E5AA8" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M240,84 C248,77 260,77 274,84" fill="none" stroke="#1E5AA8" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- front leg + shoe (leading) -->
  <g>
    <path d="M262,246 C292,250 312,262 324,280" fill="none" stroke="#2D7DD2" stroke-width="18" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M324,280 C346,276 362,286 364,304 C366,318 354,326 340,320 C322,313 312,300 312,300 Z" fill="#DA291C"/>
    <path d="M356,300 C348,296 338,296 330,299 L330,307 C338,304 348,304 354,308 Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="336" y="299" width="8" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#FFD100" transform="rotate(22 340 303)"/>
    <ellipse cx="360" cy="312" rx="9" ry="5.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- front arm + glove (leading) -->
  <g>
    <path d="M252,150 C284,150 304,160 322,178" fill="none" stroke="#2D7DD2" stroke-width="15" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="326" cy="182" r="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <path d="M312,178 q-6,8 2,15 M340,178 q6,8 -2,15" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
</svg>
```

A few notes on the build: the figure runs rightward with a forward lean, trailing limbs stretched back and leading limbs reaching forward for that classic running silhouette. The eyes use the modern connected-green look (post-1998 Sonic) rather than the all-black classic eyes; if you'd rather have Genesis-era Sonic, swap the green `#00A859` irises for `#1A1A1A`. The buckle and toe caps are kept small so the red shoe still reads as the dominant element.
